title: The core of the star collapses under gravity.
purpose: Describe the collapse that leads to a neutron star.
narration: The core's own gravity becomes unstoppable, crushing it down. Protons and electrons merge into neutrons, releasing a flood of neutrinos. The collapse halts only when nuclear forces push back, creating an ultra-dense neutron star.
